```{r}
# preparation of data in ML format and making checks

marker_genes <- unique(endo.markers$gene) 

marker_genes <- marker_genes[marker_genes %in% rownames(endo)]

expr_mat <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(endo, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[marker_genes, ]))
dim(expr_mat)

labels <- as.factor(endo$seurat_clusters)
ml_data <- data.frame(expr_mat)
ml_data$cluster <- labels


# create train-test sets 

set.seed(42)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(ml_data$cluster, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- ml_data[trainIndex, ]
test_data  <- ml_data[-trainIndex, ]


# train random forests

set.seed(42)
rf_model <- ranger(cluster ~ ., data = train_data, num.trees = 200, importance = "impurity", probability=TRUE)

set.seed(42)
rf_model_2000 <- ranger(cluster ~ ., data = train_data, num.trees = 2000, importance = "impurity", probability=TRUE)

set.seed(42)
rf_model_5000 <- ranger(cluster ~ ., data = train_data, num.trees = 5000, importance = "impurity", probability=TRUE)


# test on train data - 2000 trees

set.seed(42)
train_preds_prob_2000 <- predict(rf_model_2000, data=train_data)$predictions
train_preds_2000 <- colnames(train_preds_prob_2000)[max.col(train_preds_prob_2000)]
train_preds_2000 <- factor(train_preds_2000, levels = levels(train_data$cluster))
yardstick::accuracy_vec(train_data$cluster, train_preds_2000)


# 5-fold validation - 200 trees

set.seed(42)

ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5, verboseIter = FALSE)

rf_cv <- train(cluster ~ ., data = train_data, method = "ranger", trControl = ctrl, importance="impurity", num.trees = 200)

rf_cv$results %>%
  select(mtry, Accuracy)


# test on test data 

set.seed(42)
rf_pred_test <- predict(rf_model, data=test_data)
probs_200 <- rf_pred_test$predictions
predicted_200 <- colnames(probs_200)[max.col(probs_200, ties.method = "first")]
pred_labels_200 <- factor(predicted_200, levels=levels(test_data$cluster))
results_200 <- tibble(
  truth=test_data$cluster,
  predicted=pred_labels_200
)

set.seed(42)
rf_pred_test_2000 <- predict(rf_model_2000, data=test_data)
probs_2000 <- rf_pred_test_2000$predictions
predicted_2000 <- colnames(probs_2000)[max.col(probs_2000, ties.method = "first")]
pred_labels_2000 <- factor(predicted_2000, levels=levels(test_data$cluster))
results_2000 <- tibble(
  truth=test_data$cluster,
  predicted=pred_labels_2000
)

set.seed(42)
rf_pred_test_5000 <- predict(rf_model_5000, data=test_data)
probs_5000 <- rf_pred_test_5000$predictions
predicted_5000 <- colnames(probs_5000)[max.col(probs_5000, ties.method = "first")]
pred_labels_5000 <- factor(predicted_5000, levels=levels(test_data$cluster))
results_5000 <- tibble(
  truth=test_data$cluster,
  predicted=pred_labels_5000
)


# result metrics and overall effect of number of trees

multi_metrics <- metric_set(
  yardstick::accuracy,
  yardstick::precision,
  yardstick::recall,
  yardstick::f_meas,
  yardstick::mcc
)
results_200 <- results_200 %>%
  mutate(trees = "200")
results_2000 <- results_2000 %>%
  mutate(trees = "2000")
results_5000 <- results_5000 %>%
  mutate(trees = "5000")
all_results <- bind_rows(
  results_200,
  results_2000,
  results_5000
)
metrics_df <- all_results %>%
  group_by(trees) %>%
  multi_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = predicted)

fig2_plot2 <- ggplot(metrics_df, aes(x = trees, y = .estimate, fill = .metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=9), axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=9), axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5)
    ) +  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance by Number of Trees",
    x = "Number of Trees",
    y = "Metric Value",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))


# feature importance - 200 trees

imp_200 <- data.frame(
  feature = names(rf_model$variable.importance), importance = rf_model$variable.importance
)

imp_top20_200 <- imp %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:20)

feat_imp_200 <- ggplot(imp_top20_200, aes(x=reorder(feature, importance), y=importance)) + 
  geom_col(fill="steelblue", color="black", width=0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Feature Importance (200 trees)", subtitle = "Which features contribute most to classification?", x="Feature", y="Importance") + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(size=13, hjust=0.5), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=9), axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=9), axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))


# confusion matrices - 2000 trees

cm_2000 <- confusionMatrix(results_2000$predicted, results_2000$truth)
cm_2000 <- as.matrix(cm_2000)
cm_2000_df <- as.data.frame(cm_2000)
cm_2000_long <- cm_2000_df %>%
  mutate(Predicted = rownames(cm_2000_df)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Predicted,
    names_to = "Actual",
    values_to = "Count"
  )
cluster_levels <- unique(cm_2000_long$Actual)
cluster_levels <- cluster_levels[order(as.numeric(cluster_levels))]

cm_2000_long <- cm_2000_long %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = cluster_levels),
    Actual    = factor(Actual, levels = cluster_levels)
  )

fig2_plot1 <- ggplot(cm_2000_long, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey90") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=9), axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=9), axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix (2000 trees)",
    x = "Predicted cluster",
    y = "Actual cluster"
  )

cm_2000_norm <- cm_2000_long %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(cm_2000_norm, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Proportion)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Proportion)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
   theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=9), axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=9), axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +  theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized Confusion Matrix (by True Class)",
    x = "Predicted cluster",
    y = "Actual cluster"
  )


# feature importance - 2000 trees

imp <- data.frame(
  feature = names(rf_model_2000$variable.importance), importance = rf_model_2000$variable.importance
)

imp_top20 <- imp %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  dplyr:: slice(1:20)

fig2_plot3 <- ggplot(imp_top20, aes(x=reorder(feature, importance), y=importance)) + 
  geom_col(fill="steelblue", color="black", width=0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Feature Importance (2000 trees)", subtitle = "Which features contribute most to classification?", x="Feature", y="Importance") + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(size=13, hjust=0.5), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=9), axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=9), axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))

```
